title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — AI infrastructure led, small caps tagged records. Semis surged on AI earnings, cooler CPI eased Fed fears, oil and geopolitics capped Dow. Tape was a broadening AI-led risk-on with defensive rotation underneath.

INDICES — VIX 14.6, below 17.0 20-day MA. SOXX +2.32%, QQQ +0.73%, IWM +0.57%, SPY +0.25%, DIA -0.02%. Large > small by 0.16pp. Gold +0.99% led cross-asset; no SPY/QQQ below 200-day.

VOLUME — SPY 0.7x, QQQ not listed but sector average 0.73x; SPY volume down with price up = low-conviction rally. GLD 1.3x and SLV 1.2x elevated with gains — accumulation in metals. KWEB 2.0x volume on -1.96% drop = distribution.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLK +1.49%, XLRE +0.93%, XLU +0.48%, XLP +0.46%, XLV +0.26%, XLF +0.21%, XLE +0.16%, XLI +0.10%, XLC -0.90%, XLY -1.13%, XLB -1.24%. Top: DRAM +7.68%, SOXX +2.32%; Bottom: XHB -1.77%, KWEB -1.96%. Money into AI hardware and real estate; out of discretionary, materials, China tech. Broadening participation.

POSITIONING — QQQ PCR_vol 1.49 = heavy protection demand; SPY 0.96 neutral. QQQ skew +6.3% elevated fear; VIX below 20-day = complacency overall. MOVE 72.1 above 69.8 MA — mild bond vol stress.

CROSS-ASSET — Oil -0.24% despite Hormuz headlines, failing to sustain gains while gold +0.99% — risk-off metals bid against equity strength. Dollar +0.21% steady, not pressuring EM or commodities.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Greed 65.2. Top movers: ANET +6.39% on AI demand, TER +6.11% (CEO insider sale, no catalyst), ORCL +5.36% on TikTok news. Momentum: best XLE +8.02% 20d, worst XLC -2.74% 20d. Watch: SMH +2.08% — gamma flip proximity on QQQ at 731 vs spot; XHB -1.77% — housing weakness with rate sensitivity; IWB momentum break — Russell record close needs confirmation.
